Get ready to impress everyone with your dance moves at upcoming festival house parties- Learn your choreo at this event!

About this Event

Bollywood JamJoin us for an exciting Bollywood Jam at Klubhouse! Experience the vibrant energy and unforgettable rhythms of Bollywood in person. Learn from our talented choreographer from Sama Dance Academy- Sunaina Kokal.
Date & Time: October 25, 2026 at 1:00 PM (Pacific Daylight Time)
Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to celebrate Bollywood culture live and in full swing.
Be in comfortable clothes, bring waterbottles and your best energy!
Hydrate yourself after- Boba drink will be available for purchase.
When people ask where did you learn these dance moves from- mention Aura Events Bollywood Jam!
For sponsorship opportunities, contact us at c2Fzc2V2ZW50c2luYyB8IGdtYWlsICEgY29t.
